summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 357,105 unregistered Class I common shares for $8,512,599, or approximately $23.84 per share, sold as of September 1, 2026 to feeder vehicles under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. The Fund also declared monthly distributions of $0.1800 gross per share across Class I, S and D, payable September 30, 2026 and paid around October 29, 2026, with August NAV of $23.84 and a 9.06% annualized Class I distribution rate. Routine interval-fund capital activity; no special-situation angle.
